gaps: G1 Questions about a line's subject click the line: the fast path has no sentence-shape test on multi-entry/root layers, and F1 counts only 1-2 content words - 38 of 207 near-misses click a plain line ('who is Thonar' -> 'I need to see Thonar.'; 'is Thorald safe' -> Fralia's turn-in 'Thorald is safe.'; 'what can I do' -> TCIY's accept, SetStage 10).

G2 Commits are explicit-released by a QUESTION with the same content words: S4.3 has no shape or person test - 14 of 207 near-misses click an irreversible line without asking ('are you ready' -> 'I'm ready.' (Madanach's escape); 'can you do that' -> Styrr's 'I can do that.'; 'is Grisvar dead' -> 'Grisvar is dead.'; 'what's in Alva's journal' -> the turn-in; 'what's your job' -> Adelaisa's commit single).

G3 Commit grading is dense: 86 of 209 beats are commits (69 ask_once + 17 scene lines that become commits after the proof); many are plain QUESTIONS carrying a fragment or goodbye ('Did you see what happened here?' x3 witnesses, 'Are the murders being investigated?', 'How can you be sure your son is alive?', 'So why haven't you arrested him?', 'Who's behind all this?'); 87 of 1,045 paraphrases park and cost one confirmation; 21 near-miss questions park a commit.

G4 Invisible Continue siblings count as scripted (capability map U2): 8 beats become commits although every sibling leads to the same answer (Thonar 'Will you talk now?', Braig's three stories, Viola's poster, Madanach's intro, Saadia 'Maybe. What do you want?', Avulstein 'on my own', Jorleif 'Calixto ... was the real killer').

G5 Journal-quest scenes are read-only until the first proven click: 24 beats (11%) - Camilla's escort, Eltrys's shrine forcegreet, Dryston's brawl, the MS01 guard ambush (the Cidhna Mine hand-off), Madanach's scene and escape, Thonar's exit, Kematu at Swindler's Den, Avulstein's house, the Bards College induction.

G6 Short lines: an exact 1.0 needs 3 tokens, so 2-token commits never release on the player's own words ('I'm ready.', 'Let's go.', 'Understand? How?'); 3-word check lines fail the >= 4-word rail even verbatim ('How about now?' bribe, 'I wasn't asking.' intimidate); assent-led paraphrases on multi-entry layers match nothing ('okay, I'll do it' -> 0.549 on Kematu's 'All right, I'll do it.').

G7 Negation parity refuses positive paraphrases of negatively-worded lines: 'I need a shiv to kill Grisvar' vs 'I can't kill Grisvar without a shiv.'; 'I couldn't beat them all' vs 'I was unable to defeat them all'; 'doesn't this belong to the court mage' vs 'Shouldn't the court mage have it?' (the inversion exception covers pronouns only, not 'shouldn't the').

G8 STT damage to proper nouns: 33 of 418 damaged variants click nothing, almost all where the name was the only meaning word ('wears madonna', 'i've killed holdin', 'if tore old is alive where is he', 'lexie con burden ...'); 10 park.
